title: Jetty default error page disclosed
description: The response is the Jetty default error page: the HTTP error heading with the "Powered by Jetty" footer. It confirms the exact servlet container and its version line, which the application itself does not otherwise advertise.
remediation: Configure a custom error page and remove the container version from the footer.
limitation: One response body. The rule recognises the container template; the version it prints may be older than the running build.

observation.body:
HTTP ERROR 404 Not Found

Powered by Jetty:// 11.0.15

Page not found

Back to the shop
Set a custom error handler so the container does not render its default page.
